name: Tailoring FAQ
summary: Questions about measurements, fittings, fabric and how custom orders work.

items.question: How many fittings will I need?
items.answer: Most structured garments like suits and gowns need two fittings. Shirts, trousers and simpler pieces are usually finalised in one. We'll confirm the exact number during your consultation.

items.question: Can I supply my own fabric?
items.answer: Yes. Many traditional and occasion pieces are made from client-supplied fabric. Bring at least the yardage recommended for your garment style, and we'll confirm the exact amount needed at consultation.

items.question: Do you keep my measurements on file?
items.answer: Yes — every client gets a saved pattern file after their first order, so future pieces can often skip a full measurement session.

items.question: Can I order remotely if I don't live near an atelier?
items.answer: Yes. We support remote orders with a guided self-measurement kit, video consultations, and photo-based fitting checks before final stitching.

items.question: What if the final fit isn't right?
items.answer: Any fit issue identified at final fitting is corrected free of charge within 14 days of delivery, as outlined in our refund policy.
